references.text: Psalm 107:23-30 describes sailors experiencing a storm at sea and crying out to the Lord in their distress, and He brings them out of their troubles, which mirrors the disciples' experience and Jesus' power over nature.

In Isaiah 43:2 it is promised that when you walk through water, I will be with you, and through rivers, they shall not overwhelm you, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of God's presence and protection through dangers, just as Jesus was with the disciples.
Matthew 8:23-27 also tells the story of Jesus calming the storm, providing a parallel event that underscores Jesus' divine power.
Luke 8:22-25 gives another account of Jesus calming the storm, demonstrating Jesus' power over natural forces and His care for His disciples.
